description: On a two-element domain, \(\forall x\,\exists y\,(x=y)\) is true, but its Skolem form \(\forall x\,(x=f(x))\) fails when \(f\) is constantly zero and holds when \(f\) is the identity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.arbitrary_expansion_counterexample :
  (∀ (x : Bool), ∃ y, x = y) ∧
    (¬∀ (x : Bool), x = Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.constantFalse x) ∧ ∀ (x : Bool), x = id x
